narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two plus eight is ten, so the root of twenty eight is ten.
<bookmark mark='again'/>Ten still has two digits. Add them again, and one plus zero is one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A digital root always has a single digit, from one to nine.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 2 + 8 = 10, root 10; then 1 + 0 = 1 appears in the accent colour; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Adding the same number each time moves the root round a ring of nine.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Write the digital roots of the multiples of five, from five to forty five.
